mission.posting: #CLIENT# wants a competitors hiring strategy temporarily put out of commission.

email.subject: Hiring Sabotage
email.body:
Greetings,
Our company is about to begin a new staffing project to bring in some new talent, and we'd like the edge against our competitors, who are likely looking to do the same thing. The effort should not take long, and all we'll need is their contact details removed from their website, to make sure the prospective candidates contact us first.
You'll find a link to the website we wish to have modified attached.
Thankyou, -#CLIENT#
